name: Atalanta's Bow
lore: The huntress raised by bears, fastest of mortals, who drew first blood on the Calydonian Boar before any of the heroes could land a spear. Meleager awarded her the hide, and his uncles died for the slight. Her arrow flies straight to the first thing that draws breath in her sights.
curve_note: base_damage = curve.weapon_base_damage(27) x 1.5 unique-mult, rounded. Class: finesse 5-rung [0.20, 0.55, 1.00, 1.80, 3.00]. F20-29 Asterion-era band fill.
